entities.name: Miloš Aligrudić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miloš Aligrudić is a Serbian politician and lawyer by profession. He is the current head of the ministerial group of the Democratic Party of Serbia in the National Assembly. In 2008, he was elected vice-president of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, where he is Head of Serbian delegation. He graduated from the University of Belgrade's Law School.
